output.title: Pebble upgrade affects only cert-manager's ACME E2E test suite
output.content: The change upgrades Pebble to v2.7.0 and adjusts cert-manager's own ACME E2E tests. The release notes list it under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)", and the excerpt describes only test changes. Nothing in it touches shipped runtime behavior, chart values or CRDs. The environment's values keys, such as global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole and webhook.timeoutSeconds, and its manifests, such as cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, are not reached by it.
